'''West Atirha''' is a sub-continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Ipfehr Bay]] and [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] to the south, [[Srandan Ocean]] to the northwest, and the [[Central Atirha]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|3,207,421|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 17th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 104,089,667 as of 1765, making it also the 21st largest sub-continent by population.
